appearance.bark_look.thickness.note: The genus's bark thickness as its reference species', arbutus-menziesii (plantgen-claude project-files/bark/records/arbutus-menziesii.json): text: FOFEM 0.060; old trunks 1/3-1/2 in (Sargent) as the cap

appearance.bark_look.stages.red.note: The genus's red stage as its reference species, arbutus-menziesii, shows it (plantgen-claude project-files/bark/records/arbutus-menziesii.json): stage: text: 'bark dark red, smooth, until mid season when outer bark exfoliates, inner bark green, soon weathering to dark red' (FNA); 'large, thin scales' (FEIS); 'smooth satin sheen' (Wikipedia); young colours green, chartreuse, orange (FEIS); until_diameter_m: inferred (photo): FNA says the retained area grows with age

appearance.bark_look.stages.retained gre.note: The genus's retained grey stage as its reference species, arbutus-menziesii, shows it (plantgen-claude project-files/bark/records/arbutus-menziesii.json): stage: text: 'retained on oldest portions of main axis and on abaxial sides of larger lateral axes ... becoming roughened dark gray' (FNA); 'small thick plate-like scales' (Sargent).
